steps.label: Set up covered fighting spot
steps.detail: Make cover beside the spawner before fighting blazes.

steps.label: Gather blaze capability
steps.detail: Six rods provide twelve powder; existing powder or eyes also count toward this milestone.

steps.label: Hold eyes of ender
steps.detail: One eye uses one pearl and one blaze powder; each rod yields two powder. Aim for about 12 eyes for throws and empty portal frames. Each frame begins filled only 10% of the time, and 1 in 5 thrown eyes

steps.label: Find the stronghold
steps.detail: Follow thrown eyes to the stronghold and locate its End portal.

steps.label: Set an Overworld End portal respawn
steps.detail: Place and use a bed beside the End portal in the Overworld before entry. Beds explode in the Nether and End; an End bed is optional explosive ammunition, not a respawn point.

steps.label: Enter the End
steps.detail: Fill the empty frames and step through the End portal.

steps.label: Destroy End crystals
steps.detail: Caged crystals count too. Arrows stop at iron bars, so climb to a caged crystal or shoot it from above.

steps.label: Defeat the Ender Dragon
steps.detail: Wait on open island ground 10-15 blocks from the central bedrock fountain, within perch range. Hit the perched dragon's head for full melee damage. With no nearby player it leaves in about 5 seconds;

judge.rubric: Goal: beat the game; the next stage is Nether access. The player holds an iron pickaxe and an empty bucket, flint, 9 gravel, at y64 in the Overworld (open sky). Vanilla facts: still lava pools of 10+ sources lie on the lava floors near y-45 to y-54 (below y-54 cave air is lava); above y-20 usable pools are rare. A frame is cast with a water bucket at such a pool and lit with flint and steel. Good: a concrete action that starts or continues the descent toward the lava floors (for example dig_to stairs_down or shaft toward y-45 or lower, or moving down a known cave toward that depth), or one short concrete step to fill the bucket at water or break gravel already in view within about 16 blocks before descending. Bad: waiting or finishing with no action running; climbing to the surface or travelling or exploring on the surface to look for lava, water, gravel or wool when no specific source there is in view or remembered; a long horizontal search above y-20. Neutral: reads, plan or intent updates, crafting or tool selection alone. Judge only from the facts in the wake.

cases.rationale: Regression check: with the pearl step independent, a player at y>0 with an iron pickaxe and bucket still heads for the lava floors (pearls are open but not the next stage). Each moment appears with the E3 plan and the candidate plan.
